items.title: PERSONAL EXPERIENCE
items.quote: I continued to put my hope in Hashem. He leaned down toward me and heard my cry.
items.text: Encourage others by recounting occasions in which He responded to your tefillos by coming to your aid.

items.quote: He raised me from a black pit, from the clinging mire.

items.title: A NEW SONG
items.quote: He has put a new song in my mouth, of praise to our G-d.
items.text: Use the power of song to praise Hashem and inspire people to revere Him.

items.title: BITACHON
items.quote: Fortunate is the man who put his trust in Hashem.
items.text: Trust in Hashem and not in smooth-talking people who claim they can solve your problems.

items.quote: He wisely did not turn to the braggarts that turn away deceitfully when there is trouble.

items.title: WONDERS
items.quote: You have done many great things. You, Hashem, my G-d [have performed] Your wonders and Your plans for us.
items.text: Praise Hashem for the wonders He has performed to save Klal Yisrael.

items.quote: Were I to tell others or speak, [I would fail, as] they are too numerous to recount.

items.title: SINCERITY
items.quote: You did not want a korban shelamim or a korban minchah.
items.text: It is not enough to go through the motions of saying tefillos and doing mitzvos. Hashem will not be pleased unless your actions are accompanied by a measure of devotion and sincerity.

items.quote: My G-d, it has been my desire to carry out Your will.
Your Torah has not just been on my lips, but within my innards.

items.title: MAJESTY IN NUMBERS
items.quote: I have proclaimed [Your] benevolence in a great assembly.
items.text: Participate in large gatherings to maximize the glory and awareness of Hashem.

items.title: URGENCY
items.quote: May it be Your will, Hashem, to save me. Hashem, hurry to my assistance.
items.text: Express your plea to be saved with urgency. This emphasizes how dependent you are on Hashem’s yeshuah.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.quote: As for me, I am poor and destitute, [yet] my L-rd treats me as important.
items.text: Even though you have been granted public honors, you should see yourself as poor and destitute because everything you have comes from Hashem.

items.quote: You are my Help and my Rescuer; my G-d, do not delay.
